Press Release: $750,000 Legacy Gift Strengthens the Future of LGBTQIA+ Organizations in Central Ohio

Through his estate, Stout left a combined $750,000 legacy gift to Stonewall Columbus, Kaleidoscope Youth Center, and Equality Ohio, creating a lasting investment in LGBTQIA+ advocacy, young people, community, and belonging.
